game_tagline: Start with a handful of berries. Gather wood, build a home, and follow the hills down into the caves.
death_grave_hint: Your belongings await where you fell. Returning home…
use_hint: Look at a workbench, chest, furnace, door, bed or beacon
select_block: Select a building block in the hotbar
select_food: Select food in your hotbar first
door_needs_room: A door needs two clear blocks
crops_need_water: Crops need water within three blocks
empty_station_first: Empty this station before picking it up
furnace_lit: Furnace lit. Collect the result when it finishes
harvested: Harvested wheat. The crop will grow again
make_room_for_belongings: Make room in your backpack to recover your belongings
bed_needs_floor: Leave clear floor beside the bed
home_set_build_roof: Home set. Build a roof before sleeping
home_set_sleep_at_night: Home set. Come back at night to sleep
threat_near_bed: A threat can reach the bed. Secure your shelter
siege_subtitle: Stay within {radius} blocks of it for {seconds} seconds
beacon_held_subtitle: It now keeps the night away from your home
beacon_already_held: Your beacon already protects this home
objective_free_play: Your world is yours. Explore and improve your home
title_eyebrow: A world to make your own
title_saves: Your world saves automatically on this device.
reset_warning: Replacing your save permanently erases this world — your home, chests and progress. Expedition is a challenge run: 3 lives, and it ends after the third death.
reset_warning_short: This permanently erases your current world. Expedition: 3 lives, ends on the third death.
siege_sub: Stay within 24 blocks of the beacon
backpack_help: Select a tool to equip it. Select a backpack stack to swap it into the selected hotbar slot. Press F to eat held food.
chest_sub: Click a stack to move it across
furnace_idle: Idle — pick a recipe to light it
